result: Reviewed bacterial UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-21. Pectinesterase A, PemA (P0C1A9, Dickeya dadantii), secreted, EC 3.1.1.11: [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl methyl ester](n) + n H2O = [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n) + n methanol + n H+. Endo-polygalacturonase PehA (P26509, Pectobacterium parmentieri), secreted, EC 3.2.1.15: (1,4-alpha-D-galacturonosyl)n+m + H2O = (1,4-alpha-D-galacturonosyl)n + (1,4-alpha-D-galacturonosyl)m. Alpha-galacturonidase LplD (P39130, Bacillus subtilis), EC 3.2.1.67: [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n) + H2O = alpha-D-galacturonate + [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n-1). Escherichia coli K-12: uronate isomerase UxaC (P0A8G3, EC 5.3.1.12), aldehydo-D-galacturonate = keto-D-tagaturonate; altronate oxidoreductase UxaB (P0A6L7, EC 1.1.1.58), D-altronate + NAD+ = keto-D-tagaturonate + NADH + H+; altronate dehydratase UxaA (P42604, EC 4.2.1.7), D-altronate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O, cofactor Fe2+ (Mn2+ can substitute); 2-dehydro-3-deoxygluconokinase KdgK (P37647, EC 2.7.1.45), 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + ATP = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate + ADP + H+; KDPG aldolase Eda (P0A955, EC 4.1.2.14), cytoplasmic, 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + pyruvate.
